listening.title: Presenting September numbers to the director

lines.speaker: Phương (Finance Analyst)
lines.text: Good morning, Mr. Hải. Let me start with a quick overview of September.

lines.speaker: Hải (Finance Director)
lines.text: Sure. Keep it short, I have another meeting at ten.

lines.speaker: Phương (Finance Analyst)
lines.text: Of course. Total sales were on target, at forty-five billion dong.

lines.speaker: Phương (Finance Analyst)
lines.text: Net profit was three billion. That is a small decline compared to August.

lines.speaker: Phương (Finance Analyst)
lines.text: As this chart shows, shipping costs went up by twelve percent, so our margin was lower.

lines.speaker: Hải (Finance Director)
lines.text: I see. Is that a one-time problem?

lines.speaker: Phương (Finance Analyst)
lines.text: We think so. Fuel prices are now steady, so October should be better.

lines.speaker: Hải (Finance Director)
lines.text: Okay. Please send me the slides and one page with the key numbers.

questions.q: How were total sales in September?

options: Shipping costs went up by twelve percent

questions.q: What does Mr. Hải ask for at the end?
options: The slides and one page of key numbers

shadowing: Let me give you a quick overview of the numbers for this month.
As you can see on this chart, our costs went up in August.
The main reason for the decline is higher shipping costs this quarter.
We are still on target for the year, so there is no big risk.
I can send you the detailed report after this meeting if you like.
